notes: No permanent VEDIC or producer IDs allocated. Source sub-bodies cannot be represented as standalone functions. Activation evidence is static, not execution proof. Candidate word relationships are not permanent IDs. Finance and engineering values are illustrative.

entries.purpose: Estimate DC capacity, AC capacity, land area and module logistics from a proposed solar plant configuration.
inputs: opts.physical: mod_wp, mod_l, mod_w, gcr, gross_factor, mods_pallet, mods_container, spare_pct
entries.mechanical: DC MWp = modules × module Wp / 1e6. AC = direct value or DC divided by ratio. Net module area = count × L × W; array area divides by GCR; gross area multiplies site factor. Logistics counts round upward.
entries.limits: No site survey, layout feasibility, cable or grid capacity proof. Direct AC value is accepted without verifying MW versus MVA. Positive packaging divisors are assumed.
entries.activation: String or Central tab; change Module Rating, Mounting & GCR, Gross Site Factor or topology inputs; inspect calculated stats.

entries.purpose: Translate string-inverter hierarchy and skid/ring counts into a plant capacity and engineering-warning record.
entries.mechanical: Blocks = rings × skids per ring; modules = blocks × inverters per skid × strings per inverter × modules per string. Inverter MVA = inverter count × kVA / 1000; ring MVA = skid rating × skids per ring.
entries.limits: AC direct uses skid MVA as MW; power factor, derating and export limits are not established. Warning text is screening only.
entries.activation: String tab; change Modules per String, Strings per String Inverter, String Inverters per Skid or ring counts.

entries.purpose: Estimate string, combiner, inverter and ring counts for a central-inverter solar layout.
inputs: central AC/DC ratings and skid MVA
entries.mechanical: String kWp = modules per string × module Wp / 1000; strings = ceil(inverter DC kW / string kWp); combiner boxes = ceil(strings / strings per box). Blocks = units per skid × skids per ring × rings. L147 multiplies blocks by skid MVA and units per skid again.
entries.limits: Potential double multiplication of units per skid at L147; MVA also labelled MW. Do not reuse as certified AC-capacity logic. Verify engineering assumptions independently.
entries.activation: Central tab; change Central Inverter Units per Skid, Central Skids per 33 kV Ring Main or combiner inputs.

entries.purpose: Populate indicative development cost and assumed success probability from a selected milestone.
outputs: writes development cost field and success probability field
entries.mechanical: Copies selected stage value to cost field; maps seven fixed stage values to percentages 10,15,30,55,70,80,95.
entries.limits: Defaults are hardcoded assumptions, not empirical probabilities or actual planning outcomes.
entries.activation: Open Baseline Project Economics; select Development Stage and inspect the editable cost and success fields.

entries.purpose: Project annual and cumulative solar generation under loss, bifacial gain and degradation assumptions.
entries.mechanical: Clamp total loss to 0–100%; year one = MWp × base yield × (1+bifacial/100) × (1-loss/100); sum geometric annual degradation through years 25 and 35.
entries.limits: Not irradiance/time-series simulation. No validated weather, clipping or curtailment; degradation input is not clamped in this block. Generation totals are internal inputs to revenue.
entries.activation: Baseline Project Economics; change Base Yield, Bifacial Gain, Base Losses or Degradation; inspect revenue projections as downstream effects.

entries.purpose: Estimate annual storage-cycle revenue and combine it with solar revenue projections.
entries.mechanical: Storage value = MWh × cycles × £/MWh × efficiency; combine with solar generation × unit income, repeat constant storage value over 25 and 35 years.
entries.limits: No dispatch, degradation, tariff, availability, power-duration constraints or revenue-stack optimisation. Storage value is an assumed screening estimate.
entries.activation: Baseline Project Economics; edit BESS energy, cycles, efficiency and revenue per MWh; inspect Year 1/25/35 Revenue.

entries.purpose: Estimate solar and storage project capital expenditure and normalise it per DC watt peak.
entries.mechanical: Base capex = DC MWp × 1e6 × summed £/Wp rates; add percentage contingency on base capex, fixed cost and storage energy × £/MWh; divide by DC Wp when positive.
entries.limits: Rates are user assumptions, not offers or priced designs. No contingency on fixed/BESS cost in this implementation.
entries.activation: Baseline Project Economics > CAPEX; change rates or contingency; inspect Total CAPEX and CAPEX per Wp.

entries.purpose: Subtract constant operating cost and upfront capital cost from cumulative revenue.
entries.mechanical: Annual OPEX = AC MW × OPEX rate; surplus = cumulative revenue − annual OPEX × years − total capex. Span overlaps CAPEX as a dependency, not a new independent primitive.
entries.limits: No discounting, tax, finance, inflation or debt schedule. Not NPV, IRR or bankable cash flow.
entries.activation: Baseline Project Economics; change OPEX and CAPEX assumptions; inspect Undiscounted 25/35 Year Cash Surplus.

entries.purpose: Translate £/Wp development and exit assumptions into indicative capital at risk, margin and probability-weighted value.
entries.mechanical: Multiply DC Wp by each rate; gross margin = exit − total build cost; risk-adjusted value = margin × success percentage; multiple = margin / capital at risk when positive.
entries.limits: Operating NPV is an input multiplied by capacity, not discounted cash-flow valuation. Success weighting ignores failure costs and timing; devYears is not used here.
entries.activation: Baseline Project Economics > Development Financials; edit stage, costs, exit and probability; inspect risk-adjusted value and multiple.

entries.purpose: Generate warning messages when selected financial, electrical or logistics assumptions cross hardcoded thresholds.
inputs: DOM: electrical loss fields and gross factor
entries.mechanical: Build warning list from input signs, ranges, pricing, losses, BESS duration, cycles, site factor and packaging, then render it.
entries.limits: Thresholds are hardcoded and not independently verified or current regulatory advice. Negative electricity prices can occur; warning text is not a validation of market rules.
entries.activation: Baseline Project Economics; change assumptions and inspect displayed warnings.
